richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sikar

c: Sikar in the Shekhawati region has grown into an education town, with schools, coaching institutes and hostels full of students who spend long hours sitting at a desk. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sikar for these campuses, and for municipal parks and residential colonies too. Our Fun Fitness range is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 940 km away, and reaches Rajasthan by road.

An open gym near a hostel gives students a quick way to move between study sessions, without a membership or a trainer. The machines use body weight, so a short session is safe for teenagers and staff alike. We send a layout drawing with each station and its clear space marked, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it once you approve.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit hostel students?
items.a: Strength stations such as the pull-up station, ab trainer, chest press and leg press are popular with students. A walker or twister is good for warming up first.

items.q: How do we stop dust from damaging the machines?
items.a: Install them on a paved or rubber-floored base, sweep the area regularly and wipe moving parts. Our after-sales team can advise on a simple care routine.

items.q: Can coaching institutes with small compounds fit an outdoor gym?
items.a: Often, yes. Combination frames give two or three exercises on one base. Send us the size of the space and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.
